text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 553 September 11, 1974
AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 43 "PROVIDING FOR THE ACCELERATED
DEVELOPMENT OF THE FISHERY INDUSTRY OF THE PHILIPPINES," TO PROVIDE EFFECTIVE
MEANS TO INSURE THE SUPPLY OF FISH AND FISHERY/AQUATIC PRODUCTS AT
REASONABLE PRICES
WHEREAS, the effect of the recent calamities which befell the country tended to raise the prices of the basic
necessities of life including the price of fish and fishery/aquatic products;
WHEREAS, the price of fish, which is the major and cheapest source of protein in the diet of our people, has
escalated to a level beyond the reach of the great mass of our people due to the destruction wrought upon
fishponds, fishpens and fish nurseries by the recent typhoons and floods;
WHEREAS, unless measures are taken immediately and decisively to bring the price of fish fry and
fingerlings to reasonable levels, the price of fish will continue to be high and beyond what our people can
WHEREAS, the price of "bangus" fry and fingerlings have, recently and on several occasions in the past, risen
to unreasonable level due to monopolistic and speculative practices of certain sectors of the industry;
WHEREAS, notwithstanding the high cost of "bangus" fry, the gatherers thereof have not received their just
and proportionate share in the increment, because they have remained miserably paid for their labor the entire
increment going, as it has always gone before, to the concessionaires and middlemen; and
WHEREAS, it is the declared policy of the Government in the New Society to spread the benefits accruing to
any industry to all the sectors thereof to hasten the narrowing of the gap between the rich and the poor;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, hereby amend Presidential Decree No. 43 by adding the following
subparagraph to paragraph B, section 6 thereof:
"19. PRESCRIBE AND COLLECT FEES FOR THE ISSUANCE OF LICENSES OR PERMITS, WITH OR
WITHOUT A DEFINITE AREA OF COVERAGE, GRANTING FISHERY PRIVILEGES SUCH AS
CULTURING, CAPTURE OR GATHERING OF FISH OR FRY AND FINGERLINGS OR ANY SPECIE
OF FISH, OR FISHERY/AQUATIC PRODUCTS: PROVIDED, THAT, WHEN DUE TO DESTRUCTION
WROUGHT UPON FISHPONDS, FISHPENS OR FISH NURSERIES, BY TYPHOONS, FLOODS AND
OTHER FORTUITOUS EVENTS, OR DUE TO SPECULATION, MONOPOLISTIC AND OTHER
PERNICIOUS PRACTICES WHICH TEND TO CREATE AN ARTIFICIAL SHORTAGE OF FRY
AND/OR FINGERLING, THE SUPPLY OF FISH AND FISHERY/AQUATIC PRODUCTS CAN
REASONABLY BE EXPECTED TO FALL BELOW THE USUAL DEMAND THEREFOR AND THE
PRICE THEREOF, TO INCREASE, THE SECRETARY, UPON THE RECOMMENDATION OF THE
DIRECTOR, IS HEREBY AUTHORIZED TO FIX A FAIR AND REASONABLE PRICE FOR FRY AND
FINGERLING OF ANY SPECIE OF FISH, AND, IN SO DOING AND WHEN NECESSARY, FIX
DIFFERENT PRICE LEVELS FOR VARIOUS AREAS OR REGIONS TAKING INTO ACCOUNT SUCH
VARIABLE FACTORS AS AVAILABILITY, ACCESSIBILITY TO TRANSPORTATION FACILITIES,
PACKING AND CRATING: PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE PRICE SO FIXED SHALL
GUARANTEE THE GATHERERS OF FRY A JUST AND EQUITABLE RETURN FOR THEIR LABOR:
PROVIDED, FINALLY, THAT ANY ADMINISTRATIVE ORDER OF SAID SECRETARY, FIXING
SUCH PRICE SHALL TAKE EFFECT IMMEDIATELY, THE PROVISION OF ANY LAW TO THE
CONTRARY NOTWITHSTANDING."
This Decree shall take effect upon its promulgation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
